subject: Fixed: 0024 downgrade 'kind in ()' (integrated a6c003b)
body: Cause: 0026 and 0029 rewrite agent_health_kind_check as kind = any('{a,b}'::text[]); 0024 extracted kinds with a regex that only matched quoted words ('a'), so after 0026's downgrade it found none and built 'kind in ()'. Fix (0024 upgrade and downgrade): match words after a quote, brace or comma, which reads both the ARRAY['a'::text] and the '{a,b}'::text[] forms. Verified on a fresh stack (supabase/postgres + storage-api): tests/db/test_migrations.py + tests/test_migrate.py 13 passed; walked head 0029 -> 0017 -> 0029 -> 0024 -> 0023 -> 0029 and checked the constraint keeps exactly the right kinds at each step. Gate green on integrate (1553 unit tests).
